input.command:
cd /home/agent/repos/jsonschema && BIN=build/src/jsonschema; TMP=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$TMP/schema.json" <<'EOF'
{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://example.com", "$ref": "nested" }
EOF
mkdir "$TMP/schemas"
cat > "$TMP/schemas/remote.json" <<'EOF'
{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://example.com/nested", "type": "string" }
EOF
echo "===== bundle --without-id stderr ====="; "$BIN" bundle "$TMP/schema.json" --resolve "$TMP/schemas" --without-id 2>&1 >/dev/null
rm -rf "$TMP"
